teaser.en: Digo gardeners call the big hybrid eggplant *bungulia ra chizungu*, setting it apart from the older local kinds.
teaser.sw: Wakulima wa Kidigo huita biringani kubwa ya mbegu chotara *bungulia ra chizungu*, ili kuitofautisha na aina za zamani za kienyeji.

summary.en: *Bungulia* is the eggplant or brinjal, a garden vegetable cooked in curries. Digo growers keep several varieties, including a newer hybrid.
summary.sw: *Bungulia* ni biringani au bilingani, mboga ya bustanini inayopikwa kwenye mchuzi. Wakulima wa Kidigo hupanda aina kadhaa, ikiwemo aina mpya chotara.

about.en: *Bungulia* is a bushy plant with large, soft, slightly fuzzy leaves and purple star-shaped flowers, typical of the nightshade family. The fruits are glossy and smooth, and depending on the variety may be long or round, deep purple, white or striped. The flesh is pale and spongy.
about.sw: *Bungulia* ni mmea wenye matawi mengi, majani makubwa, laini na yenye vinyweleo kidogo, na maua ya zambarau yenye umbo la nyota, kama ilivyo kawaida kwa familia ya mnavu. Matunda yake yanang'aa na ni laini; kutegemea aina, yanaweza kuwa marefu au ya mviringo, ya zambarau iliyokolea, meupe au yenye mistari. Nyama yake ni nyeupe-nyeupe na kama sifongo.

where.en: It is grown in home gardens on the south coast.
where.sw: Hupandwa katika bustani za nyumbani pwani ya kusini.

uses.en: The fruit is cooked in curries.

names.en: The Digo name is *bungulia* (plural *mabungulia*). Varieties include *bungulia ra chizungu*, a hybrid. Swahili calls it *biringani* or *bilingani*. In English it is eggplant, brinjal or aubergine.
names.sw: Jina la Kidigo ni *bungulia* (wingi *mabungulia*). Aina zake ni pamoja na *bungulia ra chizungu*, aina chotara. Kwa Kiswahili huitwa *biringani* au *bilingani*. Kwa Kiingereza huitwa *eggplant*, *brinjal* au *aubergine*.

reason.sw: Jenasi moja; ngogwe, biringani ya Kiafrika

reason.en: Same genus; a wild relative used in medicine
reason.sw: Jenasi moja; jamaa wa porini anayetumika kama dawa
